text: Fenlow have made me reset my password after this morning.
style: Merrin & Sallow's reception and facilities lead, in her 40s, warm and reassuring. Speak with a consistent north-west England accent from Lancashire throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
pronunciation_note: Fenlow is one word, a company name, said FEN-loh (rhymes with 'Ben-oh'), never 'Fenn and Love'. Say it smoothly as a single word.
